title: Chat templates and incremental detokenization
brief: Build a prompt from messages, then stream tokens back as text without breaking multi-byte characters.
hints: The assistant turn is opened but never closed: the model continues from there.
A UTF-8 character can straddle two tokens, so decode the accumulated ids and emit only the new, complete suffix.
bytes.decode('utf-8', errors='strict') raises on an incomplete sequence; catch it and wait for more.
